WITH spatial_with_funding AS (
  SELECT 
    p.fundflux,
    sp.boxx,
    sp.boxy,
    sp.aream2,
    sp.volm3
  FROM projects p
  JOIN scanspatial sp ON p.arcregistry = sp.arcref
  WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL
    AND sp.boxx IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxx != 0
    AND sp.boxy IS NOT NULL
    AND sp.aream2 IS NOT NULL
    AND sp.volm3 IS NOT NULL AND sp.volm3 != 0
),
funding_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    fundflux,
    AVG((boxy - boxx) / boxx) as avg_y_vs_x,
    AVG(aream2 / volm3) as area_to_volume
  FROM spatial_with_funding
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
cross_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(area_to_volume) as global_avg_area_volume
  FROM funding_metrics
)
SELECT 
  fm.fundflux,
  fm.avg_y_vs_x,
  fm.area_to_volume,
  fm.area_to_volume - ca.global_avg_area_volume as difference_from_avg
FROM funding_metrics fm, cross_avg ca
WHERE fm.area_to_volume > ca.global_avg_area_volume
ORDER BY fm.fundflux
